description.value: The study investigated lifetime cannabis-use effects on regional brain morphology using structural MRI in a longitudinal cohort, with whole-brain voxel-based morphometry and follow-up ROI mixed-model analyses controlling for substance exposure, familial risk, demographic, and prenatal covariates.

spans.text: The present report investigated the effects of lifetime cannabis use on brain morphology while controlling for lifetime use of alcohol and cigarettes in individuals followed longitudinally through adolescence and young adulthood.
